title: The Empty Feast
text: A long table laid for a feast, food still warm, chairs pushed back as if everyone stood up at once and fled. A goblet lies spilled. A placecard at the head of the table names your poorest House, in fine gold ink.

options.label: The poorest House takes the head of the table.

outcomes.text: The food is real, and very good, and nobody comes back. Nobody.
The guests come back, and they are hungry, and they are not angry that you sat. They are pleased.
Very fine silver, and very cold, and it never warms.
The candles go out behind you, one by one. The smell of the food follows you for a day, and your own bread tastes of ash beside it.
